note: Authored titles and one-sentence descriptions of product-owned fixtures (the regression and policy corpora this repository generates; benchmarks/generated-populations.json). A public evidence case's title belongs to credential-evidence and is read from benchmarks/evidence-case-metadata.json, never authored here. Display text only: no fixture index identity, corpus hash or scored value reads this file. Describe what the bytes exercise, never a value from them.

policy-qualified-credentials--bearer-tok.title: A bearer token in an HTTP Authorization header
policy-qualified-credentials--bearer-tok.description: Checks that the value after Authorization: Bearer is redacted under the bounded project-policy contract for bearer tokens.

policy-qualified-credentials--bearer-tok.title: A bearer value below the policy length floor
policy-qualified-credentials--bearer-tok.description: The same Authorization header with a value shorter than the frozen project-policy floor; nothing should be flagged.

policy-qualified-credentials--connection.title: A password in the userinfo of a PostgreSQL connection URL
policy-qualified-credentials--connection.description: Checks that only the password between the user name and the host is redacted in a postgres:// URL.

policy-qualified-credentials--otpauth-ur.title: A TOTP secret after other query parameters in an otpauth URI
policy-qualified-credentials--otpauth-ur.description: Checks that the secret parameter of an otpauth://totp URI is redacted when issuer comes before it and algorithm after it.

policy-qualified-credentials--generic-to.title: A quoted value assigned to api_key
policy-qualified-credentials--generic-to.description: Checks that a high-entropy literal under a high-signal credential field name is redacted by the generic-token policy.

policy-qualified-credentials--generic-to.title: A short literal assigned to password
policy-qualified-credentials--generic-to.description: Checks the generic-token policy on a short direct literal under a credential field name, where the expected action is a warning, not a redaction.
